policy_summary: The official Football-Data fair-use page, updated 2026-11-24, limits free CSV/Excel use to private personal-betting or academic research, allows at most light automated access twice per week, and excludes commercial or AI data-training projects involving automated bots/scrapers.
policy_interpretation: The project has no provider-issued permission for automated capture or frozen inference. The two-download-sessions-per-week ceiling is not an authorization. Because this is an AI project and the official fair-use page excludes AI data-training projects involving automated bots/scrapers, automated source capture, frozen-model inference, and AI model training remain denied. The manifest keeps authorization null and all corresponding permission flags false. This is a conservative internal control, not a legal conclusion about every form of personal or academic research.
